user.title: Add a tide location
user.description: Tides are computed locally from sun/moon astronomy for this location — no API key needed. Accuracy is an approximation; use the calibration offset in options to nudge it to match your local tide table.

data_description.tidal_range: Typical local high-to-low tide swing, used to scale the displayed wave.
data_description.calibration_offset: Shift the predicted high/low times to match a known local tide table.
